items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: So we were friends forever after you know. ... And it was wonderful, because I was family, and for the rest of my life, and for as long as he lived, I was family

ctx.x: And then, but I had an older brother that Duke was also very fond of. And he and I would listen and go to things together. And so that way, he and his friends who were going on to © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
college, they trained me you know, and they were beginning to play something. And they’d say, “Well that’s a clarinet you know.” And I would tell them, “That’s what’s good.”
